<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark">
  <title>Circle</title>
  <style>
    *,
    *::before,
    *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }
    :root {
      --bg: #fff;
      --fg: #111;
    }
    @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
      :root {
        --bg: #111;
        --fg: #eee;
      }
    }
    body {
      min-height: 100vh;
      min-height: 100dvh;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      padding: 1rem;
      background: var(--bg);
      color: var(--fg);
    }
    svg {
      display: block;
      width: min(400px, 100%);
      height: auto;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <main>
    <svg id="ae683f770" viewBox="0 0 400 400" role="img" aria-labelledby="ae683f770-title">
      <title id="ae683f770-title">Circle</title>
      <circle cx="200" cy="200" r="200" fill="currentColor"/>
    </svg>
  </main>
</body>
</html>
